notes.title: Dev log 2
notes.notes:
This issue introduces the relevant content of the fighter Verdant Jackdaw in the game.

Verdant Jackdaw, The second-generation balanced multi-role fighter, has combat capabilities in different spaces such as atmosphere and space. It is also equipped with a Swift II propellant jet device and a special wireless unmanned long-range attack system Sparrow (ie wingman)

In the setting, the Verdant Jackdaw is an advanced fighter belonging to the Interstellar United Defense Federation which is piloted by a special operator Jue.

In terms of appearance design, the Verdant Jackdaw follows the split design of the Jackdaw series fighter, and it’s equipped with a Frost MK-IV type weapon system and equipped with two Crowfeather MK-II propellers, making it quite strong in terms of firepower and maneuverability. The cab is more centered, which can ensure the safety of the pilot to a greater extent.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821324/3f4b0d44b74f7255ce1498a105b604a559632a39.jpg[/img]

Overall performance: balanced in all aspects

Weapon introduction:

Weapon 1 - Frost diffuser, a large-scale scattering weapon, enemies in the front and rear can both be attacked.
Features - super large range, high attack frequency
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821324/2521dadd4f8b596e3b2657bc45b569cb5897fc2a.gif[/img]

·Weapon 2 - Frozen ice thorns, fire a column of ice thorns, the ice thorns have extremely high damage, and can quickly resolve the enemy when they continue to attack the same target.
·Features - concentrated attack, extremely high damage
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821324/5a9345e21b7b155a5685cc180e91a9adfb37d501.gif[/img]

·Weapon 3 - Ice burst energy cannon, a weapon with tracking and induction ability, which has a good effect on enemies in tricky positions. The induction bomb can automatically counterattack while avoiding enemy attacks. (Compared to Scarlet Swallow's Tracking Blade, the attack angle is reduced but the attack speed is increased.)
Features - Tracking Induced Attacks
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821324/f08ec311ff8c881f5d26b9657fdf71f8a9436f81.gif[/img]

·Charging Skill - Blades Feather, shoots light blade bullets to the front sector area, which can eliminate the enemy's barrage and cause higher damage to nearby enemies. Moderate cooldown.
Features - Deal high damage while clearing enemy barrage
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821324/ee1b6f43b39bc414722cd1f7b5d6b40fabc22fbd.gif[/img]

·Nirvana - Extreme Ice Field, causing multiple stages of high damage to all enemies.
Features - full screen attack
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821324/4b124a7aa83a3c5afbcfe4c8e2e3f9197e022d3c.gif[/img]

At present, our demo has been released on steam. If you are interested in this game, please go to the store to download and experience.

Finally, if you have any questions or feedback, you can join the official QQ group(335444850) and provide us with the description of the problem, screenshots, screen recordings, etc., and we will verify and fix it as soon as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821324/6ab47964b97c4c16a18e9a0783daa3b074e7f509.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev log 1
notes.notes:
With the "Thunderbird" demo released on Steam,some of our game mechanics, gameplay, background introduction and other related production information will also be published here one after another.

This issue introduces the relevant content of the fighter Scarlet Swallow in the game.

Scarlet Swallow,The third-generation agile space fighter, is equipped with a gravity control system, which can switch operations in the atmosphere and space.It is also equipped with a Swift II propellant jet device and a special wireless unmanned long-range attack system Sparrow (ie wingman)

In the setting, the Scarlet Swallow is an advanced fighter belonging to the Interstellar United Defense Federation which is piloted by a special operator Ling.

In terms of appearance design, in order to highlight the core concept of dexterity and agility, the Scarlet Swallow adopts the design of flat composite wing suit, which strengthens the stability under high-speed flight and can easily make some difficult maneuvers. (p.s.:The pink and white color matching is chosen by Ling herself)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821324/90feff2aa163fe8a45b989ede1d69686e41c30c0.jpg[/img]

Comprehensive performance: balanced firepower, fast speed

Weapon introduction:

Weapon 1 - Vulcan machine gun, a weapon that focuses on attack distance and continuous fire, it is better for large-scale enemies in all directions, and also has high damage at close range.
Features - Large range, high attack frequency

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821324/97eda03c4c23e29386e716748025ce51805f22ba.gif[/img]

Weapon 2 - Energy launcher, focusing on attack power and penetrating weapons, has stronger lethality against large bodies, and can directly attack internal enemies through fortifications.
Features - concentrated attack, high damage, able to penetrate

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821324/ec61720b8ca917bea7e11934ea4b31b0593f7f36.gif[/img]

Weapon 3 - Tracking Light Blade, a weapon with tracking induction ability, which has a better effect on enemies in tricky positions. The induction bomb can automatically counterattack while avoiding the enemy's attack.
Features - Tracking Induced Attacks

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821324/cd36bafea93194caeddf80092acd2e844bfd664b.gif[/img]

Charge Skill - Energy defense position, energy defense position appears around itself, which can reflect the enemy's attack, the maintenance time of the protection matrix is long, and relatively the recharging time is long.
Features - Has both defensive ability and charge output ability

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821324/cfe1bb171a0e553c60ba223ef0c57d622f10e1fb.gif[/img]

Nirvana - Death Blossom, a large mother bomb splits dozens of bullets for range blasting.
Features - Multi-stage blasting at fixed points, causing high damage

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821324/bfdbfac4fe78da2a592750f8992e4d2bd0b5e85d.gif[/img]

At present, our demo has been released on steam. If you are interested in this game, please go to the store to download and experience.

Finally, if you have any questions or feedback, you can join the official QQ group(335444850) and provide us with the description of the problem, screenshots, screen recordings, etc., and we will verify and fix it as soon as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821324/6ab47964b97c4c16a18e9a0783daa3b074e7f509.png[/img]

notes.title: 雷鸟Thunderbird Demo small patch
notes.notes:
Game content adjustments:
Type-a and Type-B will have two different sound effects when hit
Added selection sound when first entering the game selection language
Added selection sound when selecting difficulty
During the game, the HI score display at the top of the screen is adjusted to display the highest score of the corresponding mode of the corresponding body
Changed to do not shoot when some enemy positions are at the bottom of the panel
Horizontal movement speed of red mainframes has been increased
BUG fix:
Fixed an issue where leaderboards could not continue counting when they exceeded 10
Fixed an issue where gold nuggets could not be retrieved by rotating around the machine
Fixed bug Mc-117516 - Select body interface button, click to determine inaccurate
Fixed a tank factory where tanks could be destroyed by partitions before leaving the house
Fixed a problem where helicopters on the apron would be tracked by tracking bullets when not taking off without judgment
Fixed an issue where the first wave of enemies would shake
Fixed some map mismatch hierarchy errors
